title: International tsunami threat message
description: A Pacific-style international tsunami threat message for a distant source: the earthquake parameters, an evaluation, and a list of coasts with the forecast wave amplitude above the tide (greater than 3 m, 1 to 3 m, 0.3 to 1 m, less than 0.3 m) and the estimated arrival time of the first wave. It is advice to national authorities; each country decides its own warnings.

examples: Magnitude 8.4, 1332Z 05 NOV 2026, 21.3 S 70.1 W, depth 25 km
Hazardous tsunami waves are possible for some coasts located within 1000 km of the earthquake and tsunami waves are possible for coasts farther away.

coasts.description: Coasts or countries with forecast wave amplitude and first arrival (up to 10)

threat.description: Forecast wave amplitude above the tide level. The older Threat, Potential threat and No threat categories are still accepted

examples: This message is for national authorities. Local warnings are issued by each country.
